description: The pipeline produces one image tagged with the commit, and every environment deploys that same digest with its own configuration.
CLI flags that stop `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` from repeating the previous step, keeping the pipeline fast and each step's output explicit.
The NuGet lock file enabled by `RestorePackagesWithLockFile`; `dotnet restore --locked-mode` fails when it does not match the project.
A file that pins the .NET SDK version for a repository, read by `actions/setup-dotnet` and by `UseDotNet@2` with `useGlobalJson`.
The GitHub Action that installs the .NET SDK on a runner and can cache NuGet packages keyed by the lock file.
Azure Pipelines tasks that install the SDK and wrap `dotnet` CLI commands, publishing test results to the run summary.
A CI login to a cloud provider with a short-lived token issued per run, instead of long-lived keys stored as secrets.
